cues.say: Component 16: Pre-scaling. Add server copies and upgrade the database before a spike you know is coming. You'll bring this up during the spike defenses.
Think of it as: Calling in extra staff before the lunch rush, not during it. Use it for any planned event.
Here's a real scenario. The snow forecast airs on the 6 PM news. Tire-shop traffic will jump 20 times in 2 minutes.
Without it: Autoscaling notices the busy servers at 6:06.
4 minutes of errors at the worst moment.
With it: 5 PM: 2 to 6 copies, bigger database, CDN warmed.
6:05: the spike arrives; the system is already sized.
Why it works: You know when the spike is coming, so use that.
In the interview, say: Autoscaling reacts in minutes. The spike arrives in seconds.
A few related terms you may hear.
Autoscaling: The cloud adds copies when servers get busy. Keep it as a safety net.
Workers: Scale them on queue length, not CPU.
